brief:
Trump is pressuring Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to remove National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir from his government, the Ma'an news agency reported. The pressure campaign signals U.S. efforts to reshape Israel's governing coalition at a moment of regional tension.

Trump's move appears designed to pave the way for a national unity government, according to the report. The U.S. position reflects broader concerns about Ben-Gvir's role and influence within Netanyahu's administration.
title: Trump pressures Netanyahu to remove Ben-Gvir from cabinet
